notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Food.
description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Witch's Oven.
Resolve the Witch's Oven ability, creating a Food token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a tapped Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
